############################################################

```{r}
files <- list.files(raw_dir, full.names = TRUE)

strip_suffix <- function(x) sub("_(matrix\\.mtx\\.gz|features\\.tsv\\.gz|barcodes\\.tsv\\.gz)$", "", x)

mtx <- files[grepl("_matrix\\.mtx\\.gz$", files)]
feat <- files[grepl("_features\\.tsv\\.gz$", files)]
bar <- files[grepl("_barcodes\\.tsv\\.gz$", files)]

prefix_mtx <- strip_suffix(basename(mtx))
prefix_feat <- strip_suffix(basename(feat))
prefix_bar <- strip_suffix(basename(bar))

common_prefix <- Reduce(intersect, list(prefix_mtx, prefix_feat, prefix_bar))
length(common_prefix)
head(common_prefix, 10)

```


```{r}
read_one_10x_triplet_safe <- function(prefix, raw_dir) {
  tryCatch({
    mtx_path  <- file.path(raw_dir, paste0(prefix, "_matrix.mtx.gz"))
    feat_path <- file.path(raw_dir, paste0(prefix, "_features.tsv.gz"))
    bar_path  <- file.path(raw_dir, paste0(prefix, "_barcodes.tsv.gz"))

    feat_preview <- data.table::fread(
      cmd = paste("zcat", shQuote(feat_path), "| head -n 5"),
      header = FALSE, data.table = FALSE
    )
    feature_col <- if (ncol(feat_preview) >= 2) 2 else 1

    mat <- ReadMtx(
      mtx = mtx_path,
      features = feat_path,
      cells = bar_path,
      feature.column = feature_col
    )

    obj <- CreateSeuratObject(mat, project = prefix, min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
    obj$sample_id <- prefix
    obj
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Skipping sample (failed to load): ", prefix, "  |  reason: ", conditionMessage(e))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

seurat_list <- lapply(common_prefix, read_one_10x_triplet_safe, raw_dir = raw_dir)
names(seurat_list) <- common_prefix

ok <- !vapply(seurat_list, is.null, logical(1))
failed_samples <- names(seurat_list)[!ok]
seurat_list <- seurat_list[ok]

cat("Loaded samples:", length(seurat_list), "\n")
cat("Failed samples:", length(failed_samples), "\n")
if (length(failed_samples) > 0) print(failed_samples)

seurat_list[[1]]
```

```{r}
min_genes <- 200
max_genes <- 6000
max_mt    <- 15
min_cells_per_gene <- 5

for (i in seq_along(seurat_list)) {
  seurat_list[[i]][["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_list[[i]], pattern = "^MT-")
  seurat_list[[i]] <- subset(
    seurat_list[[i]],
    subset = nFeature_RNA >= min_genes &
             nFeature_RNA <= max_genes &
             percent.mt <= max_mt
  )

  counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_list[[i]], layer = "counts")
  keep_genes <- Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0) >= min_cells_per_gene
  seurat_list[[i]] <- seurat_list[[i]][keep_genes, ]
}

  n_cells = vapply(seurat_list, ncol, numeric(1)),

) %>% arrange(desc(n_cells))
```

```{r}
run_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_col, out_prefix,
                         max_cells_per_group = 3000, min_cells = 10) {

  stopifnot(group_col %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data))

  Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  groups <- levels(Idents(seurat_obj))

  cells_use <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = g)
    if (length(cells) > max_cells_per_group) sample(cells, max_cells_per_group) else cells
  }))

  seurat_ccc <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells_use)

  DefaultAssay(seurat_ccc) <- "RNA"
  seurat_ccc <- JoinLayers(seurat_ccc, assay = "RNA")

  data_input <- GetAssayData(seurat_ccc, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

  meta <- data.frame(
    group   = seurat_ccc[[group_col, drop = TRUE]],
    samples = seurat_ccc$sample_id,
    row.names = colnames(seurat_ccc)
  )

  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta, group.by = "group")
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.human

  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)

  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat, do.fast = FALSE)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, population.size = TRUE)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = min_cells)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

  df_edges <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)

  write.csv(df_edges, paste0("ccc_results_r/", out_prefix, "_edges.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  saveRDS(cellchat, paste0("ccc_results_r/", out_prefix, "_cellchat_object.rds"))

  return(list(cellchat = cellchat, edges = df_edges, seurat_used = seurat_ccc))
}

)
```

```{r}
tumor_meta_path <- "~/Downloads/GSE174554_Tumor_normal_metadata.txt"

lines <- trimws(lines)
lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]

parts <- strsplit(lines, "\\s+")               
parts <- parts[vapply(parts, length, 1L) >= 2] 

tumor_meta <- data.frame(
  sample_barcode = vapply(parts, `[[`, character(1), 1),
  tumor_normal   = vapply(parts, `[[`, character(1), 2),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tumor_meta <- tumor_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(sample_barcode) != "sample#_barcode") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_barcode = sub("-1$", "", trimws(sample_barcode)),
    tumor_normal   = trimws(tumor_normal)
  )

meta <- seurat_top5k@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sf_id = ifelse(grepl("SF[0-9]+", sample_id),
                   sub(".*(SF[0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_id),
                   sub(".*(SF[0-9]+).*", "\\1", cell_id)),
    barcode_only = sub("^.*_", "", cell_id),
    barcode_only = sub("-1$", "", barcode_only),
    sample_barcode = paste0(sf_id, "_", barcode_only)
```

```{r}
seurat_rna <- seurat_top5k

prep_seurat <- function(obj) {
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
  obj
}

cap_cells_by_group <- function(obj, group_col, max_cells_per_group = 3000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  stopifnot(group_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
  Idents(obj) <- obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  groups <- levels(Idents(obj))
  cells_use <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    cells <- WhichCells(obj, idents = g)
    if (length(cells) > max_cells_per_group) sample(cells, max_cells_per_group) else cells
  }))
  subset(obj, cells = cells_use)
}

inspect_gene_ids <- function(obj, n = 10) {
  x <- rownames(obj)
  cat("\n--- Gene ID debug ---\n")
  cat("Example rownames:\n"); print(head(x, n))
  cat("Looks like ENSG?        ", mean(grepl("^ENSG", x)), "\n")
  cat("Contains ENSG versions? ", mean(grepl("^ENSG.*\\.", x)), "\n")
  cat("----------------------\n\n")
}

get_lr_pairs_from_LRdb <- function() {
  data(LRdb, package = "SingleCellSignalR")

  cat("\n--- LRdb columns (your install) ---\n")
  print(colnames(LRdb))
  cat("----------------------------------\n\n")

  cn <- colnames(LRdb)

  ligand_candidates <- c("Ligand.ApprovedSymbol","ligand","Ligand","ligand_gene_symbol",
                         "Ligand_symbol","ligand_symbol","gene_A","Gene1","from")
  receptor_candidates <- c("Receptor.ApprovedSymbol","receptor","Receptor","receptor_gene_symbol",
                           "Receptor_symbol","receptor_symbol","gene_B","Gene2","to")

  lig_col <- ligand_candidates[ligand_candidates %in% cn][1]
  rec_col <- receptor_candidates[receptor_candidates %in% cn][1]

  if (is.na(lig_col) || is.na(rec_col)) {
    stop("Could not auto-detect ligand/receptor columns in LRdb. Paste colnames(LRdb) output.")
  }

  message("Using LRdb columns: ligand = ", lig_col, " | receptor = ", rec_col)

  LRdb %>%
    dplyr::transmute(ligand = .data[[lig_col]], receptor = .data[[rec_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ligand), !is.na(receptor)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

run_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_col, out_prefix,
                         max_cells_per_group = 1200,
                         min_cells = 10,
                         seed = 42) {

  seurat_obj <- prep_seurat(seurat_obj)

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  keep_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)[!is.na(grp)]
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = keep_cells)

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  tab <- table(grp)
  keep_groups <- names(tab[tab >= min_cells])
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = colnames(seurat_obj)[grp %in% keep_groups])

  seurat_obj <- cap_cells_by_group(seurat_obj, group_col, max_cells_per_group, seed)

  data_input <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

  meta <- data.frame(
    group   = as.factor(seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]),
    samples = as.factor(if ("sample_id" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) seurat_obj$sample_id else "sample1"),
    row.names = colnames(seurat_obj)
  )

  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta, group.by = "group")
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.human

  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat, do.fast = FALSE)  # avoids presto requirement
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, population.size = TRUE)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = min_cells)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

  df_edges <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)

  write.csv(df_edges, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_edges.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  saveRDS(cellchat, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_object.rds")))

  df_edges
}

run_baseline_lrscore <- function(seurat_obj, group_col, out_prefix, top_k_per_lr = 20) {
  seurat_obj <- prep_seurat(seurat_obj)

  lr <- get_lr_pairs_from_LRdb()
  avg <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, assays = "RNA", layer = "data", group.by = group_col)$RNA

  lr <- lr %>% filter(ligand %in% rownames(avg), receptor %in% rownames(avg))
  message("LR pairs after gene-overlap filtering: ", nrow(lr))
  if (nrow(lr) == 0) stop("No LR pairs overlap with your expression genes. Check gene symbols.")

  groups <- colnames(avg)

  res_list <- vector("list", nrow(lr))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(lr))) {
    lig <- lr$ligand[i]; rec <- lr$receptor[i]
    L <- avg[lig, ]; R <- avg[rec, ]

    df <- expand.grid(sender = groups, receiver = groups, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$ligand <- lig
    df$receptor <- rec
    df$score <- as.numeric(L[df$sender] * R[df$receiver])

    res_list[[i]] <- df %>% arrange(desc(score)) %>% slice_head(n = top_k_per_lr)
  }

  df_baseline <- bind_rows(res_list) %>% arrange(desc(score))
  write.csv(df_baseline, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_edges.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  df_baseline
}
run_scsr <- function(seurat_obj, group_col, out_prefix,
                     max_cells_per_group = 800,
                     min_cells_per_group = 25,
                     seed = 42) {

  seurat_obj <- prep_seurat(seurat_obj)
  lr <- get_lr_pairs_from_LRdb()

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  keep_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)[!is.na(grp)]
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = keep_cells)

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  tab <- table(grp)
  keep_groups <- names(tab[tab >= min_cells_per_group])
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = colnames(seurat_obj)[grp %in% keep_groups])

  seurat_obj <- cap_cells_by_group(seurat_obj, group_col,
                                   max_cells_per_group = max_cells_per_group,
                                   seed = seed)

  grp3 <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  message("SingleCellSignalR group sizes:")
  print(sort(table(grp3)))

  counts_sp <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

  lr_genes <- unique(c(lr$ligand, lr$receptor))
  lr_genes <- lr_genes[!is.na(lr_genes)]
  genes_keep <- intersect(rownames(counts_sp), lr_genes)
  message("LR genes kept in matrix: ", length(genes_keep))

  if (length(genes_keep) < 50) {
    stop("Too few LR genes overlap after filtering (", length(genes_keep),
         "). Your gene symbols might not match LRdb naming.")
  }

  counts_sp <- counts_sp[genes_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_sp)
  storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"

  ct <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  cluster_num <- as.integer(factor(ct))
  cluster_names <- levels(factor(ct))

  outdir <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_cluster-analysis"))
  dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  oldwd <- getwd()
  setwd(outdir)
  on.exit(setwd(oldwd), add = TRUE)

  scsr_out <- cell_signaling(
    data = counts_mat,
    genes = rownames(counts_mat),
    cluster = cluster_num,
    int.type = "paracrine",
    c.names = cluster_names,
    species = "homo sapiens",
    write = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(scsr_out, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_object.rds")))
  return(scsr_out)
}
```

```{r}
RESULTS_DIR <- path.expand("~/Downloads/ccc_results_r")

smart_read <- function(f) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(f))
  df <- tryCatch({
    if (ext == "csv") readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    else readr::read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(df)) df <- tryCatch(readr::read_delim(f, delim = ",", show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) df <- tryCatch(readr::read_delim(f, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  df
}

looks_like_lr_edges <- function(df) {
  if (!is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0 || ncol(df) < 4) return(FALSE)
  cn <- tolower(colnames(df))
  has_lig  <- any(grepl("ligand|gene.?a", cn))
  has_rec  <- any(grepl("receptor|gene.?b", cn))
  has_send <- any(grepl("^from$|sender|source|cluster.?1|group.?1|cell.?1", cn))
  has_recv <- any(grepl("^to$|receiver|target|cluster.?2|group.?2|cell.?2", cn))
  has_lig && has_rec && has_send && has_recv
}

std_scsr <- function(df, grouping_name) {
  cn <- tolower(colnames(df))
  pick <- function(regex_vec) {
    hits <- which(Reduce(`|`, lapply(regex_vec, function(rx) grepl(rx, cn))))
    if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    colnames(df)[hits[1]]
  }

  lig <- pick(c("^ligand$", "ligand", "gene.?a"))
  rec <- pick(c("^receptor$", "receptor", "gene.?b"))
  snd <- pick(c("^from$", "sender", "source", "cluster.?1", "group.?1", "cell.?1"))
  rcv <- pick(c("^to$", "receiver", "target", "cluster.?2", "group.?2", "cell.?2"))
  sc  <- pick(c("^score$", "score", "weight", "prob", "intensity", "interaction"))

  if (any(is.na(c(lig, rec, snd, rcv)))) {
    stop("SCSR column mapping failed. Columns were:\n", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "))
  }

  df %>%
    transmute(
      sender   = as.character(.data[[snd]]),
      receiver = as.character(.data[[rcv]]),
      ligand   = as.character(.data[[lig]]),
      receptor = as.character(.data[[rec]]),
      score    = if (!is.na(sc)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[sc]])) else NA_real_,
      method   = "scsr",
      grouping = grouping_name
    )
}

extract_lr_df_from_object <- function(x, depth = 0, max_depth = 6) {
  if (depth > max_depth) return(NULL)

  if (is.data.frame(x) && looks_like_lr_edges(x)) return(x)

  if (is.list(x)) {
    for (nm in names(x)) {
      out <- extract_lr_df_from_object(x[[nm]], depth + 1, max_depth)
      if (!is.null(out)) return(out)
    }
  }

  if (inherits(x, "S4")) {
    for (sn in methods::slotNames(x)) {
      out <- extract_lr_df_from_object(methods::slot(x, sn), depth + 1, max_depth)
      if (!is.null(out)) return(out)
    }
  }

  NULL
}

extract_lr_df_from_results_dir <- function() {
  files <- list.files(RESULTS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE,
                      pattern = "\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$", ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  for (f in files) {
    df <- smart_read(f)
    if (!is.null(df) && looks_like_lr_edges(df)) {
      message("using SCSR edges file found on disk: ", f)
      return(df)
    }
  }
  NULL
}

get_scsr_edges <- function(rds_path, grouping_name) {
  obj <- readRDS(rds_path)

  df <- extract_lr_df_from_object(obj)
  if (is.null(df)) {
    message(" No LR edges table found inside RDS: ", basename(rds_path))
    message("   Trying disk scan under RESULTS_DIR ...")
    df <- extract_lr_df_from_results_dir()
  }

  if (is.null(df)) {
    stop("Could not find any SCSR LR edges table (neither in RDS nor on disk).\n",
         "This usually means SingleCellSignalR did not output an LR edge table in your run.")
  }

  std_scsr(df, grouping_name)
}

scsr_celltype_std <- get_scsr_edges(

)
```

```{r}
std_cellchat <- function(df, grouping, modality) {

get_spatial_coords <- function(seurat_sp) {
  if (length(seurat_sp@images) > 0) {
    coords <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(seurat_sp)
    return(as.matrix(coords[, c("x","y"), drop=FALSE]))
  }
  md <- seurat_sp@meta.data
  if (all(c("x","y") %in% colnames(md))) return(as.matrix(md[, c("x","y")]))
  if (all(c("imagerow","imagecol") %in% colnames(md))) return(as.matrix(md[, c("imagecol","imagerow")]))
  stop("No spatial coordinates found (need images or x/y or imagerow/imagecol in meta.data).")
}

compute_group_proximity <- function(coords, groups, k = 6) {
  if (!requireNamespace("RANN", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("RANN")
  nn <- RANN::nn2(coords, k = k + 1)
  idx <- nn$nn.idx[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  dst <- nn$nn.dists[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  w <- 1 / (1 + dst)

  groups <- factor(groups)
  lev <- levels(groups)
  g_idx <- as.integer(groups)

  W <- matrix(0, nrow=length(lev), ncol=length(lev), dimnames=list(lev, lev))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(idx))) {
    gi <- g_idx[i]
    js <- idx[i, ]
    gj <- g_idx[js]
    W[gi, gj] <- W[gi, gj] + sum(w[i, ])
  }
  if (sum(W) > 0) W <- W / sum(W)
  W
}

score_edges_by_proximity <- function(edges_df, prox_mat) {
  edges_df %>%
    mutate(
      prox = ifelse(sender %in% rownames(prox_mat) & receiver %in% colnames(prox_mat),
                    prox_mat[sender, receiver],
                    NA_real_)
    )
}
```

```{r}
RESULTS_DIR <- path.expand("~/Downloads/ccc_results_r")
dir.create(RESULTS_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

prep_seurat <- function(obj) {
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
  obj
}

cap_cells_by_group <- function(obj, group_col, max_cells_per_group = 2000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  Idents(obj) <- obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  groups <- levels(Idents(obj))
  cells_use <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    cells <- WhichCells(obj, idents = g)
    if (length(cells) > max_cells_per_group) sample(cells, max_cells_per_group) else cells
  }))
  subset(obj, cells = cells_use)
}

get_lr_pairs_from_LRdb <- function() {
  data(LRdb, package = "SingleCellSignalR")
  cn <- colnames(LRdb)

  ligand_candidates <- c("Ligand.ApprovedSymbol","ligand","Ligand","gene_A","Gene1","from")
  receptor_candidates <- c("Receptor.ApprovedSymbol","receptor","Receptor","gene_B","Gene2","to")

  lig_col <- ligand_candidates[ligand_candidates %in% cn][1]
  rec_col <- receptor_candidates[receptor_candidates %in% cn][1]

  if (is.na(lig_col) || is.na(rec_col)) {
    stop("Could not auto-detect ligand/receptor columns in LRdb. Columns are:\n",
         paste(cn, collapse=", "))
  }

  LRdb %>%
    transmute(ligand = .data[[lig_col]], receptor = .data[[rec_col]]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ligand), !is.na(receptor)) %>%
    distinct()
}

run_scsrproxy <- function(seurat_obj, group_col, out_prefix,
                          max_cells_per_group = 2000,
                          min_cells_per_group = 25,
                          top_k_per_lr = 20,
                          seed = 42) {

  seurat_obj <- prep_seurat(seurat_obj)

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = colnames(seurat_obj)[!is.na(grp)])

  grp <- seurat_obj[[group_col, drop = TRUE]]
  tab <- table(grp)
  keep_groups <- names(tab[tab >= min_cells_per_group])
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = colnames(seurat_obj)[grp %in% keep_groups])

  seurat_obj <- cap_cells_by_group(seurat_obj, group_col, max_cells_per_group, seed)

  lr <- get_lr_pairs_from_LRdb()

  avg <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, assays = "RNA", layer = "data", group.by = group_col)$RNA

  lr <- lr %>% filter(ligand %in% rownames(avg), receptor %in% rownames(avg))
  message(out_prefix, " | LR pairs after overlap: ", nrow(lr))
  if (nrow(lr) == 0) stop("No LR pairs overlap. Gene symbols mismatch with LRdb.")

  groups <- colnames(avg)

  res_list <- vector("list", nrow(lr))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(lr))) {
    lig <- lr$ligand[i]; rec <- lr$receptor[i]
    L <- avg[lig, ]; R <- avg[rec, ]

    df <- expand.grid(sender = groups, receiver = groups, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$ligand <- lig
    df$receptor <- rec
    df$score <- as.numeric(L[df$sender] * R[df$receiver])

    res_list[[i]] <- df %>% arrange(desc(score)) %>% slice_head(n = top_k_per_lr)
  }

  edges <- bind_rows(res_list) %>%
    mutate(method = "scsrproxy", grouping = group_col) %>%
    arrange(desc(score))

  out_csv <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, paste0(out_prefix, "_edges.csv"))
  write_csv(edges, out_csv)
  message(" Wrote: ", out_csv)
  edges
}

seurat_rna <- seurat_top5k

stopifnot("is_tumor" %in% colnames(seurat_rna@meta.data))
```

```{r}
RESULTS_DIR <- path.expand("~/Downloads/ccc_results_r")

find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- colnames(df)
  low <- tolower(nms)
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- which(grepl(p, low))
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(nms[hit[1]])
  }
  NA_character_
}

read_edges <- function(path) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  sender_col   <- find_col(df, c("^sender$", "^source$", "^from$"))
  receiver_col <- find_col(df, c("^receiver$", "^target$", "^to$"))
  ligand_col   <- find_col(df, c("^ligand$", "ligand"))
  receptor_col <- find_col(df, c("^receptor$", "receptor"))
  score_col    <- find_col(df, c("^score$", "^prob$", "weight", "communication_probability", "interaction_strength"))

  if (is.na(sender_col) || is.na(receiver_col) || is.na(ligand_col) || is.na(receptor_col)) {
    stop("Missing required columns in: ", basename(path), "\n",
         "Columns present: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "))
  }

  score_vec <- if (!is.na(score_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[score_col]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))

  tibble(
    sender   = as.character(df[[sender_col]]),
    receiver = as.character(df[[receiver_col]]),
    ligand   = as.character(df[[ligand_col]]),
    receptor = as.character(df[[receptor_col]]),
    score    = score_vec
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sender), !is.na(receiver), !is.na(ligand), !is.na(receptor)) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_pair = paste(ligand, receptor, sep="|"),
      edge_id = paste(sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, sep="|")
    )
}

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unique(a); b <- unique(b)
  if (length(a) == 0 && length(b) == 0) return(1)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}

    mutate(lr_pair = str_replace_all(lr_pair, "\\|", "→"))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(lr_pair, score_sum), y = score_sum)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~method, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = paste0("Top 15 LR pairs by aggregated score — ", grouping_name),
         x = NULL, y = "Sum(score) (within method)")

  ggsave(outpath, p, width = 10, height = 6)
}

plot_top_pairs("celltype", file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "fig7_top_pairs_barplot_celltype.png"))
plot_top_pairs("tumor",    file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "fig8_top_pairs_barplot_tumor.png"))

cat("Step 7 complete. Outputs saved in:\n  ", RESULTS_DIR, "\n\n", sep="")
```

```{r}

build_spatial_from_expr_txt <- function(expr_path,
                                       project = "GSE174554_spatial",
                                       min_features = 0,
                                       min_cells = 0,
                                       make_fake_coords = TRUE) {
  expr_path <- path.expand(expr_path)
  stopifnot(file.exists(expr_path))

  header_line <- readLines(expr_path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  spots <- gsub('"', "", unlist(strsplit(trimws(header_line), "\\s+")))
  spots <- spots[spots != ""]
  if (length(spots) < 2) stop("Could not parse spot IDs from first line.")

  lines <- readLines(expr_path, skipNul = TRUE, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[-1]
  lines <- lines[trimws(lines) != ""]
  
  parse_row <- function(ln) {
    toks <- gsub('"', "", unlist(strsplit(trimws(ln), "\\s+")))
    if (length(toks) < 2) return(NULL)
    gene <- toks[1]
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(toks[-1]))
    if (anyNA(vals)) {
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", toks[-1])))
    }
    if (length(vals) != length(spots)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    list(gene = gene, vals = vals)
  }

  parsed <- lapply(lines, parse_row)
  parsed <- parsed[!vapply(parsed, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(parsed) == 0) stop("Parsed 0 gene rows. Check file format.")

  genes <- vapply(parsed, `[[`, character(1), "gene")
  mat   <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parsed, `[[`, "vals"))

  rownames(mat) <- genes
  colnames(mat) <- spots

  mat_sp <- Matrix(mat, sparse = TRUE)

  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(mat_sp, project = project,
                            min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"


  obj$sample_id <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", colnames(obj))

  if (make_fake_coords) {
    n <- ncol(obj)
    side <- ceiling(sqrt(n))
    xy <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(side), y = seq_len(side))[seq_len(n), ]
    rownames(xy) <- colnames(obj)
    obj@meta.data$x <- xy$x
    obj@meta.data$y <- xy$y
  }

  obj
}

SPATIAL_EXPR_PATH <- "~/Downloads/GSE174554_Spatial_transcriptomic_matrix.txt"  # <-- change if needed

seurat_sp <- build_spatial_from_expr_txt(SPATIAL_EXPR_PATH)
seurat_sp
```

```{r}
RESULTS_DIR <- path.expand("/Users/yassenarab/Downloads/ccc_results_r")

find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- colnames(df)
  low <- tolower(nms)
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- which(grepl(p, low))
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(nms[hit[1]])
  }
  NA_character_
}

read_edges <- function(path) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  sender_col   <- find_col(df, c("^sender$", "^source$", "^from$"))
  receiver_col <- find_col(df, c("^receiver$", "^target$", "^to$"))
  ligand_col   <- find_col(df, c("^ligand$"))
  receptor_col <- find_col(df, c("^receptor$"))
  score_col    <- find_col(df, c("^score$", "^prob$", "weight"))

  score_vec <- if (!is.na(score_col))
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[score_col]]))
  else
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))

  tibble(
    sender   = as.character(df[[sender_col]]),
    receiver = as.character(df[[receiver_col]]),
    ligand   = as.character(df[[ligand_col]]),
    receptor = as.character(df[[receptor_col]]),
    score    = score_vec
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_pair = paste(ligand, receptor, sep="|"),
      edge_id = paste(sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, sep="|")
    )
}

safe_jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  if (length(a)==0 || length(b)==0) return(NA_real_)
  length(intersect(a,b)) / length(union(a,b))
}

files <- tribble(
  ~modality, ~method,    ~grouping,  ~file,
  "snRNA",   "cellchat", "celltype", "snRNA_cellchat_by_celltype_edges.csv",
  "snRNA",   "baseline", "celltype", "snRNA_baseline_by_celltype_edges.csv",
  "snRNA",   "cellchat", "tumor",    "snRNA_cellchat_by_tumor_edges.csv",
  "snRNA",   "baseline", "tumor",    "snRNA_baseline_by_tumor_edges.csv",

  "spatial", "cellchat", "celltype", "spatial_cellchat_by_celltype_edges.csv",
  "spatial", "baseline", "celltype", "spatial_baseline_by_celltype_edges.csv"
) %>%
  mutate(path = file.path(RESULTS_DIR, file)) %>%
  filter(file.exists(path))

edges_all <- files %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(df = list(read_edges(path))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(df)

bench_counts <- edges_all %>%
  group_by(modality, grouping, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n_distinct(lr_pair),
    n_edges = n_distinct(edge_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(bench_counts,
          file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "bench_spatial_vs_snRNA_counts.csv"))

p1 <- ggplot(bench_counts, aes(method, n_pairs, fill = modality)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~grouping) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Unique Ligand–Receptor Pairs: Spatial vs snRNA")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR,
       "fig_spatial_vs_snRNA_pairs.png"), p1, width=10, height=5)

p2 <- ggplot(bench_counts, aes(method, n_edges, fill = modality)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~grouping) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "CCC Edges: Spatial vs snRNA")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR,
       "fig_spatial_vs_snRNA_edges.png"), p2, width=10, height=5)

pairs_by <- edges_all %>%
  group_by(modality, grouping, method) %>%
  summarise(pairs = list(unique(lr_pair)), .groups="drop")

pair_jacc <- pairs_by %>%
  group_by(grouping, method) %>%
  summarise(
    spatial_vs_snRNA =
      safe_jaccard(
        pairs[modality=="spatial"],
        pairs[modality=="snRNA"]
      ),
    .groups="drop"
  )

write_csv(pair_jacc,
          file.path(RESULTS_DIR,
                    "bench_spatial_vs_snRNA_pair_jaccard.csv"))

p3 <- ggplot(pair_jacc,
             aes(method, grouping,
                 fill = spatial_vs_snRNA)) +
  geom_tile(color="white") +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.3f", spatial_vs_snRNA)), size=5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="red", na.value="grey90") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Spatial vs snRNA Pair Agreement (Jaccard)")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR,
       "fig_spatial_vs_snRNA_jaccard.png"), p3, width=8, height=4)

cat(" SAFE SPATIAL BENCHMARK COMPLETE")

print(bench_counts)
print(pair_jacc)
```
